title: Supported local stdio entrypoint
objective: Expose a supported local stdio entrypoint using the authoritative builder without changing runtime authority: document and qualify `cotra mcp stdio` (or equivalent installed entrypoint) with protected environment and lifecycle behavior, plus package configuration examples for local clients, requiring no OpenAI tunnel.

include: supported `cotra mcp stdio` or equivalent installed entrypoint reusing the SG-000048 authoritative builder
protected environment handling reusing the existing daemon env allowlist with no secret leakage
lifecycle behavior for start, stop, and diagnostics consistent with existing local policy
local client configuration examples for Claude Desktop, Codex, Mistral Vibe Code, and generic MCP clients
stdio entrypoint contract tests proving identical tool surface through the installed entrypoint
exclude: any new MCP tool, tool schema change, capability widening, approval change, or authority change
loopback HTTP listener implementation (reserved for SG-000050)
relay device transport implementation (reserved for COTRA-P15)
local client packages beyond configuration examples (reserved for SG-000051)
any P15 remote relay, OAuth, device uplink, or public edge code
any P16 tool-surface widening or provider submission

invariants: authoritative builder remains the single tool source of truth
stdio entrypoint adds no independent tool authority
protected environment allowlist unchanged with no secret leakage
no OpenAI tunnel requirement for local clients

acceptance.claim: A supported installed stdio entrypoint launches the authoritative MCP server with protected environment and lifecycle behavior.
Configuration examples enable local MCP clients without an OpenAI tunnel, with identical policy and approval behavior.
Entrypoint contract tests prove identical tool surface through the installed path, and all closed SG-000001 through SG-000048 regressions pass unchanged.
Exact-head CI including release qualification and supply-chain audit, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000050: Loopback Streamable HTTP may proceed only after SG-000049 closes, with loopback-only bind and local auth.

done_when: The supported local stdio entrypoint is canonical with configuration examples and no authority change.
